item.title: Creating an authorizer in AWS with cargo-lambda [Spanish]
item.description: In this session, we will explore how to leverage cargo-lambda to develop and deploy custom AWS Authorizers. The authorizer is used as an example to show how easy and performant is to use AWS lambdas with Rust.
